meta_title: Taller Martínez — Custom software for businesses in Torrevieja, Alicante & Murcia
meta_description: Software and apps built around the way your business actually works, in Torrevieja, Alicante province and the Region of Murcia. Eight years building software, now for businesses here.
hero_h1: The software your business needs and can't find.
hero_lead: I've spent eight years building software for companies. Now I do it for businesses here — tools built around the way you work, not the other way round.
problem_title: Your job is running your business, not wrestling a spreadsheet.
problem_intro: Every week the same hours disappear: copying figures from one place to another, writing down by hand what's already written down somewhere else, checking nobody's got it wrong. You're not working badly — you just haven't got the right tool.
problem_pain_0: Everything lives in a spreadsheet only you understand.
problem_pain_1: Orders or bookings go in a notebook, then get typed up by hand.
problem_pain_2: You've tried three different systems and none of them work the way you do.
problem_pain_3: You pay a hefty monthly licence to use about a tenth of it.
services_intro: Software made for your business, not off the shelf. This is the sort of thing I build.
services_item_0_desc: Software that does exactly what you do: orders, bookings, customers, stock, job sheets. Built around the way you already work — and it keeps going when there's no signal in the warehouse or out in the van.
services_item_1_desc: A website that brings customers in and a shop that genuinely sells. Quick, properly built, and straightforward enough that you can update it yourself.
services_item_2_desc: That weekly copy-and-paste, done for you. I connect what you already use — till, invoicing, spreadsheets, email — so the figures move on their own instead of you carrying them across by hand.
services_item_3_titulo: AI that takes work off you
services_item_3_desc: An assistant that answers customers at any hour; invoices and delivery notes that read and file themselves. The parts that genuinely save hours, in plain English and without the hype.
cases_title: Eight years building software for companies.
cases_intro: Here's some of it. Big or small, it's always the same job: a process that ran by hand, turned into something that runs itself.
cases_item_0_desc: Card balances were tracked by hand. Now the till scans the barcode, shows what's left, and adds or takes off in one tap.
cases_item_1_desc: Inspection rounds were done on paper. I replaced them with tablet forms that keep working with no signal and sync up on the way out.
cases_item_2_desc: A platform where the design team runs each season end to end — footwear, bags and accessories, all in one place.
cases_item_3_desc: Trip documentation generated straight from the booking, for travel agents and tour operators.
how_title: From the first call to having it up and running.
how_intro: No surprises and no small print. This is how a project goes with me.
how_step_0_titulo: You show me how you do it now
how_step_0_desc: A call or a coffee. I want to see the spreadsheet, the notebook, the actual mess. Free, no strings.
how_step_1_titulo: I tell you the price and the date
how_step_1_desc: A fixed quote and a fixed deadline before we start. And if I don't think it's worth it for you, I'll say so rather than sell you something.
how_step_2_desc: Within weeks you're using something real, not waiting a year for one big delivery. You try it as we go and we put things right.
how_step_3_titulo: It's left working, and it's yours
how_step_3_desc: I install it, show you how to use it, and stick around for whatever comes up. The code is yours: if you'd rather not carry on with me, you're not stuck.
how_principio_0_desc: No call centres, no ticket numbers. One person start to finish: me.
how_principio_1_desc: I explain it in plain English so you can decide with the full picture.
how_principio_2_desc: Based in Torrevieja, working across Alicante province and the Region of Murcia.
about_title: Eight years doing this. Now on your doorstep.
about_body_html: I'm Alberto Martínez. I've spent eight years building software for companies — critical platforms, SaaS products, in-house tools — and I've set up Taller Martínez to do the same for businesses round here. I work with AI every day, which means what used to take weeks now takes days: you feel that in the timeline and in the price.
about_extra_intro: Building software is the focus. But if your business needs this too, I'll take care of it.
about_extra_0_desc: That they exist, that they work, and that you can actually restore them the day it matters.
about_extra_1_desc: GDPR basics in order, no scares and no odd paperwork.
about_extra_2_desc: Which tool to use, why you're paying for three that do the same thing, a second opinion.
contact_title: Tell me what's eating your time.
contact_intro: No obligation. Drop me a line, we'll talk it through, and I'll tell you straight whether I can help, what it'd cost and how long it'd take.
